[Wed 2026-05-20 12:05 UTC] Package the ciphered text into a single compressed zip file.

arguments.command:
cd /tmp
rm -rf docs_rot13
cp -a /usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/docs docs_rot13
find docs_rot13 -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    temp=$(mktemp)
    tr 'A-Za-z' 'N-ZA-Mn-za-m' < "$file" > "$temp"
    mv "$temp" "$file"
done
zip -r /root/.openclaw/workspace/docs_ciphered.zip docs_rot13
